# Notifications

**Layer:** api + worker

## Purpose

The seam every outbound message goes through. Real logic, no delivery.

## Features

- One `sender.ts` seam for OTP codes and invitation links
- Logs the message instead of sending it

## Business rules

- [BR-NOT-001](../BusinessRules/Notifications.md#br-not-001)

## Source files

- `apps/api/src/services/notification/sender.ts`

## Known limitations

- Nothing is delivered. Blocked on TRAI DLT registration for SMS and Meta template approval for WhatsApp
- No notification templates table, no provider abstraction, no delivery-status tracking
